events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, attracting over 400,000 people to Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off, defining a generation with three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite track from the legendary line-up?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, we lost the King, Elvis Presley. His music and iconic style continue to influence generations. Which Elvis track is always on your playlist?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and founding member of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, in Akron, Ohio.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' frontwoman continues to inspire with her distinctive voice and powerful stage presence. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972, in Manchester, England.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, he's still got that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your top Liam track?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Celebration
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Today we celebrate over six decades of 007 magic, from iconic theme tunes to unforgettable gadgets. What's your favourite Bond film or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician, songwriter, and co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Imagine John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His timeless music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's your favourite song from the iconic Beatle?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedic legend John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939, in Weston-super-Mare, England.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45, due to complications from AIDS.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His incredible voice and stage presence continue to captivate millions worldwide. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?
